_meta.name: Opening Verse S.
_meta._purpose: Pre-race pool % capture for chalk-disparity flag validation. Race has not yet run.

chalk_doubt.rationale: Top-3 odds + WIN over-bet by 12pts vs PLACE. Largest gap of the day. If flag holds (4-for-4 prior), Lagynos does NOT win.

smart_money_board.rationale: P>W by 4.4pts. Place-pool over-weight signals smart money for board play.

balanced_value.rationale: All three pools within 1.5pts of each other at 4/1. Good value if chalk fades.

if_flag_holds.suggested_play: Trifecta key #4 OR #9 ALL / #5 / ALL. Ex box 4-9-5 if budget-limited.

if_flag_breaks.implication: First miss for the chalk-doubt flag in 5+ chances today. Would warrant immediate algo audit.

4_quatrocento_show_money.rationale: Show pool grew from $3.3K to $13.6K (+311%). Someone took a heavy SHOW position on #4. This is sharp money signaling #4 to hit the board with high confidence — a stronger signal than W-P disparity.

_update_15mtp.refined_play: Trifecta KEY #4 OR #9 / spread #5 #2 #8 / ALL. The show-pool spike on #4 is the cleanest live signal we've seen today.
_update_15mtp.new_pattern_to_validate: When the SHOW pool size grows >3x in <10 min on one horse approaching post, that horse is materially more likely to hit the board than its odds imply. N=1 — needs validation but worth tracking.

key_learnings: Chalk-doubt flag's morning 4-for-4 was on maiden/claiming chalks (#1 BFL 1.0, #5 SV 0.5, #5 Spotted 2.0, #8 Theoretical 2.0). R9 was a $350K stakes with Asmussen/J.Ortiz — stakes-grade chalk with top connections. The flag's category may not extend to top-end stakes races where the connections grind out wins despite over-betting.

The flag's SECONDARY signals (P>W = board, show spike = board) were both right — they correctly identified the actual 2nd and 3rd finishers. So the flag has predictive power even when the primary chalk-doubt prediction fails.

Hypothesis (NOT YET VALIDATED): split the flag into two distinct claims — (a) chalk doesn't win, segment to maiden/claiming/allowance only, and (b) the P-pool/S-pool divergent horse hits board, applies broadly. (a) goes 4-1; (b) goes 2-0.

Lagynos paid $4.54 — that's 1.27/1, tighter than his 6/5 ML. The market actually bet him DOWN further, suggesting the 6/5 ML was already conservative. Heavy sharp money on the chalk in stakes — opposite of what the flag interpreted.
_outcome.do_not_ship: N=1 miss on a previously 4-for-4 signal. Wait for 50+ races as handoff doc recommends. Document the segment hypothesis but don't add code branches yet.
